title: Spiral Spinach and Feta Börek
summary: Filo rolled around a spinach, onion and feta filling, coiled into a spiral, glazed and baked until crisp.

ingredients.item: frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
sheets filo pastry (about 35 x 23 cm, 450 g), thawed

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat 5 min, add the spinach and pepper and stir 2-3 min until no moisture is left; cool 10 min, then fold in the feta.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Whisk the oil, egg and milk together. Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and line the tray.

steps.title: Strips
steps.text: Keep the filo under the damp towel. Lay two sheets side by side with the short edges overlapping by 2 cm, brush lightly with glaze, and repeat twice more to make a three-layer strip; make four strips in all.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Spread a quarter of the filling along one long edge of a strip and roll it up loosely into a thin log.

steps.title: Coil
steps.text: Curl the first log into a snail in the middle of the tray, then attach each further log to the end so they make one large spiral.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Brush all over with the remaining glaze and bake 25-30 min until deep golden and crisp; the centre should reach 71 °C.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rest 10 min, then cut into wedges.

tips: Squeeze the spinach really dry or the pastry turns soggy.
Roll loosely so the logs do not split as they bake.
Keep unused filo covered so it does not dry out.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat at 180 °C for 10 min to re-crisp. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
